title: Decoder output
description: What an adapter's decoder returns: one result or a list of 1 to 500 results. Producer: the adapter's decoder (user code). Consumer: validateResults in services/adapters/lib/decoder.cjs, which checks every result alone against the device profile and publishes it as Sparkplug; a result that fails does so alone with a diagnostic and never discards the others. Delivery: at least once with its input (decoder-input.v1). Deduplication key: messageId per adapter and source device, for 7 days. Results of one input are published oldest observation first, and a result older than the newest already published for its source device is historical. Read tolerantly: fields the schema does not list are ignored. Not expressible here: metric names must exist in the device profile and be unique within a result, each value must match the parameter's data_type, a unit must match the profile's, and observedAt may be at most 5 minutes in the future.

sourceDeviceId.description: The manufacturer's device identifier, not blank.

name.description: A profile parameter key; unique within the result.

value.description: Typed by the profile parameter's data_type: a finite number (an integer must be a safe integer), a boolean or a string.

unit.description: When given it equals the profile parameter's unit.

observedAt.description: When the device observed the values; at most 5 minutes in the future. Without it the result is receipt-timed.

messageId.description: Deduplicates per adapter and source device for 7 days.
